headline: BTS, ENHYPEN win grand prizes on 2026 MAMA Day 1
sub: Both groups take 3 trophies each at Kyocera Dome Osaka

points.title: What to know
items: ENHYPEN win Fans' Choice daesang 2 years running
BTS, on tour, accepted via video message
ALPHA DRIVE ONE, TUIDE named Best New Artist

source: Source: Yonhap News, Dailian, SPOTV News
caption:
BTS and ENHYPEN took home the grand prizes on Day 1 of the 2026 MAMA AWARDS.

At Kyocera Dome Osaka on Nov 20, BTS won Artist of the Year, while ENHYPEN won Fans' Choice of the Year for the second year in a row. Each group took three trophies in total. BTS, currently on tour, thanked fans in a video message, and ENHYPEN's Jungwon said, "I really can't believe it. This year was truly eventful."

Other Day 1 winners include IVE (Best Female Group), TXT's Yeonjun (Best Male Artist), i-dle's Soyeon (Best Female Artist), and ALPHA DRIVE ONE and TUIDE (Best New Artist). Day 2 follows on Nov 21.

📌 Source: Yonhap News, Dailian, SPOTV News (via Korean media)
